mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 shows a sustained decline over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS show increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in the last month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as immediate concerns about economic health arise.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% in the last month signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real GDP and housing starts signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows and consumer confidence wanes.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST show declines.
